title: Beware Boiúna
overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

title: Baththa
overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

title: Dust
overview: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

title: Thella Kaagitham
overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

title: Cars: Spooky Halloween Adventure
overview: It's Halloween night in Radiator Springs, and Lightning and his best friend Mater are enjoying the festivities at the annual spooky block party. But when Lightning gets bored of the flavored gasoline, roasted lug nuts, and jack-cone-lanterns, he convinces Mater to check out the old haunted garage on the edge of town. Will the two friends be brave enough to make it through the night without getting spooked?

title: Betty Balloon
overview: Betty Balloon tells the story of a modern family - who just happen to be balloons. Mom Balloon is an inventor, Dad Balloon runs the home, Bobby Balloon is a super tweenie, and the heart of it all is Betty Balloon, a creative and imaginative four-year-old. Life turns upside down when a cactus family moves in next door. Mom Cactus, Dad Cactus, tweenie sister Karla Cactus and four-year-old Kaj Cactus. The Balloon family must learn to connect with their new neighbours, but it is the children who take the first step when Betty Balloon becomes best friends with Kaj Cactus. In the Betty Balloon universe, it is the kids who teach the adults how to open and stay curious.

title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

title: Wingman
overview: A confident relationship expert and a rising dating app CEO reunite for a high-stakes matchmaking bet. As ambition, tech money, and power couple dreams collide, a hidden college scandal threatens to destroy their second chance at love.

title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: Beyond Boy
overview: After his ship lands on Earth, an unsuspecting farmer and his wife raise a young alien boy as one of their own.

title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Mendocino
overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

title: Offroad
overview: Set under the southern sun of the Canary Islands, three friends find themselves in over their heads in pursuit of freedom, dreams and a man named Francisco.  Maggie’s (Sofie Jo Kaufmanas) life looks perfect; she has a career, a home and a boyfriend, but inside she is slowly being suffocated by expectations and the weight of her own ambitions.  With her friends Eva (Julie Rudbæk) and Stine (Katinka Lærke Petersen), she sets out on a girls’ trip to Tenerife in search of freedom and dreams. But soon, one impulsive decision sends her and her two best friends on a reckless and chaotic journey across the island in a campervan.

title: Un-static
overview: A young man summons a Unicorn in search of answers about identity, belonging and purpose, embarking on a magical journey between the weight of the past and the promise of the future.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Pardon
overview: Middle-aged couple Shen Mo and Tian Yi, facing their third seven-year itch, see their marriage erupt in a bitter clash of accumulated frustration, culminating in a 30-day cooling-off period that seems destined to conclude their relationship.

title: Traces of Justice
overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

title: Dovzhenko. First Sight
overview: Ukrainian Odesa, 1926: a city recovering from the war, a city where jazz sounds and cinema is born. Young artist Sashko Dovzhenko seeks freedom in art - and stumbles upon a system that does not forgive dreams. His first film may be his last. And he does not yet know that soon his name will be known to the whole world.

title: Warga Rusun 609
overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

title: The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: Black Market
overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

title: Watching People Watching Birds
overview: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

title: Accursed
overview: When a nun’s cursed secret resurfaces on Emma’s 21st birthday, a lake-house reunion turns deadly. A masked cult and dark prophecy force Emma and her friends to face possession, betrayal, and a midnight ritual that could raise ancient evil.

title: Bayang
overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

title: Repo
overview: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

title: The Opera!
overview: The Three Chaps; Prescott, Chogurt, and Dr. Wilbert, await to see Lady Hogsmash LIVE at The Opera. While appreciating some lobby art, a horrific travesty unfolds, leaving The Chaps to wonder if they'll make it out of The Opera House on a high note.

title: Avaraachan & Sons
overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Infirmary
overview: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Sigma
overview: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

title: SI Yugandhar
overview: An honest cop's discovery of a mysterious body launches a high-stakes investigation, forcing him to uncover a dark web of secrets hidden beneath the city's surface.

title: Anakapalli
overview: In rural Anakapalli, a young man enters the criminal underworld under a feared gangster. When love arrives, he faces a choice between power, loyalty, and his former dreams in this tale of action and destiny.

title: The Brainstorm
overview: Rosalie tries to make a film, while her roommate and her actors keep getting in her way.

title: Anbil Avan
overview: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

title: XY9
overview: Mar and Iván see parenthood as a possible answer to the fractures in their relationship. As repeated miscarriages and genetic problems complicate that hope, the couple must confront what they are asking a child to repair, and whether their shared future can survive the weight of that desire.

title: Orion
overview: A NASA interrogator is tasked with helping an amnesiac astronaut recover his memory in order to determine “who” or “what” killed the rest of the crew before they crash-landed back on Earth.

title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

title: Prem Keetanu
overview: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

title: Method
overview: After watching grief transform her classmate into a brilliant actor, an ambitious student wonders what she’s missing. "Method" is a darkly funny satire about jealousy, grief, and how far artists will go for authenticity.

title: Street Fighters
overview: The world’s best martial artists come together for a world championship organised by a mysterious organisation. As alliances are forged and enemies emerge, they soon realise there’s more at stake than the grand prize… their lives!

title: The Man from Carrickfergus
overview: Northern Ireland, 1972. IRA enforcer Josie Connors is assigned to execute Richie McGavin, a suspected traitor. But when the killing is delayed, she develops a growing connection to her unaware captive, testing her loyalty and commitment to her role.  Inspired by true events.

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Stranglehold
overview: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

title: The Influencer Project
overview: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

title: Shakira Live from Madrid
overview: This musical release from pop singer Shakira captures a live performance by the artist, recorded live in Madrid. Proudly presented by Amazon Music.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Go for Broke 2
overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

title: Overt Listening
overview: Hong Kong–born artist Tiffany Sia confronts the Cold War legacy of China in this landscape film shot amidst the serene environs of Taiwan’s Kinmen archipelago. On this stretch of land only 1,800 meters from the coast of China, deserted beaches and abandoned military bunkers and training facilities harbor echoes of past conflict, such as the 1949 Battle of Guningtou, in which Taiwan defeated the Chinese Communist Party and maintained control of the land.

title: Area Codes
overview: A girl from Stockton, Gabriella, breaks up with her long-term boyfriend and decides to help her best friend move to Los Angeles as a short getaway. At the biggest night market in LA, she meets a boy who was born and raised in SoCal, Jayson, and he shows her iconic and sentimental places within every area code of the greater LA area.

title: Mallbound
overview: Parker Shaw is a Content Creator who makes urban exploration videos. His latest investigation took place at the old condemned mall in his hometown, where a woman named Dana Morgan took her own life. In response to internet backlash against the footage he captured, he now presents his raw files from that fateful night...

title: FUN
overview: Kneading the back of an elderly man, Evie, the new masseuse at the Russian & Turkish bathhouse, finds her mind drifting from the steam room’s promise of serenity toward an absurd vision of grief.

title: Matchbox the Movie
overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

title: Radhimaa (Documentary)
overview: A micro documentary: Making of Radhimaa

title: The Salacity
overview: A morally obsessive blackmailer appoints himself the judge of other people's intimate lives. Targeting those he believes are guilty of infidelity and deception, he uses manipulation and fear to pursue his own idea of justice. As paranoia and violence intensify, his campaign exposes the obsession and desire for control beneath his moral certainty.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: When Things Move
overview: During moving day, Joaquina and her cousin Leonor turn the chaos of boxes into an adventure. Between games, jealousy, and discoveries, the girls explore the corners of a house that seems to hold a secret of its own.

title: Semicolon
overview: Two old friends reconnect after the unexpected death of their best friend.

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: Love of Your Life
overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Vampire Carnival
overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: Who Wants to Steal Your Beach?
overview: You know that beach you go to for a bit of rest? They want to take it away from you.  The so-called "Beach Amendment" (PEC das Praias)—championed in the Senate by Flávio Bolsonaro—could change who owns the Brazilian coastline, an area that belongs to everyone, by handing control over to hotels, resorts, and luxury condominium developments.  In practice, these developments would take over the entire beach area, leaving access to the sand and the sea exclusively to tourists—while you, as a Brazilian resident, would lose your access to the beach.  This model already exists in places like Cancún and Jamaica: there, the people in bikinis are foreigners, while the locals are the ones wearing uniforms and working. And that is exactly what could happen if Flávio Bolsonaro becomes president of Brazil.

title: Who Is Martin Mull?
overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

title: Stain
overview: Haunted by trauma, a psychologically unstable teenager is compelled to visit his sick grandmother with his half-sister and their friends. Being back in his childhood home, his dark past resurfaces, forcing him to confront whether the true horror lies in the island - the people from his past, or within himself.

title: Angel and the Badman
overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

title: The Beast
overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

title: Therapy Done Right
overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

title: The Spiral
overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

title: Wirbel
overview: A dilapidated house stands among the fields in the rolling landscape of the Czech Central Mountains. Its new and only inhabitant is Martin, who left the city to rediscover his lost sense of direction here. But when the mysterious Agnes appears on his doorstep, his secluded world begins to crumble. As the landscape resists and an ancient danger hidden in the soil comes to life, Martin must restore the lost memory of the place to save Agnes, the land, and himself.

title: Ibuku
overview: A destitute widow and former traditional dancer defies social ostracization to embark on a desperate international journey, seeking a final reconciliation with her estranged daughter who faces execution abroad for the murder of an abusive employer.

title: Rough Draft
overview: Much to his wife’s chagrin, Michael can’t seem to settle on the ending to his latest novel. Even though he has owed the publisher for some time now, he keeps deleting and tweaking the ending to his tale of horror, with each change ultimately affecting the outcome of the group of teens who are being killed one by one by an unknown killer in his story.

title: Inolvidable Heidi
overview: Heidi, a magical girl from the mountains who lives with her grandfather, her friends, and her rabbit Nicanor, captivates Franco, a young man from the city, with her natural charm. Franco begins sneaking away from his girlfriend, his friends, and even his teacher, just to go see this mountain girl who has stolen his heart. Despite the difficulties and his girlfriend’s interference, their love blossoms. However, an accident and a spell cause them to forget their love. Years later, fate brings them together again. They don’t remember each other, but the same love still lies dormant within them. A love story that defies memory and endures through time.

title: Ducks
overview: A young Frenchman of Cambodian origins goes to his country in search of himself.

title: Happily Married
overview: Anis and Anamika are complete opposites, brought together by an unexpected marriage. Can the responsible Anis and the free-spirited, modern Anamika overcome their differences and build a happy life together?

title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: The Pastor Who Preys
overview: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

title: The Sandbox
overview: In Singapore, a stuntman teams up with his brother and ex-sister-in-law to keep their declining stunt school alive. Just as their dream seems about to fade, a rumour that Marvel Studios is scouting locally brings a surge of wannabe superheroes and misfits to their doorstep, convinced they’ll be whipped into crime-fighting shape.

title: Oh Season
overview: Felix McCoy is a young boy grappling with the loss of his mother, the beloved creator of the town’s annual holiday pageant. When the production is hijacked and rebranded into a shallow spectacle by cocksure director Hamilton Lydell, Felix secretly sabotages the event, only to realize that saving the show might be the only way to keep his late mother’s spirit alive.

title: The Mage
overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

title: Mommy Blue
overview: The story revolves around Krisztina, an art teacher who is progressively losing her sight as a complication of diabetes. It engenders a crisis, not only in her own life but also in that of her son. Máté must contend with the state of his mother’s health immediately following the birth of his first child. He does his best to help Krisztina, but his life is gradually torn between his increasingly clingy mother and his own little family. Krisztina, meanwhile, fears being alone in the dark…

title: Apocalypse Z: New World
overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Tenzing
overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Reporting Live
overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

title: Musk
overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

title: Comrade Kalyan
overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

title: Misty Green
overview: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

title: A Prayer for the Dying
overview: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

title: Teambuilding 2
overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

title: You, Like a Star
overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
overview: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

title: Ateş
overview: After his older brother, Chief Inspector Ali, is killed in the line of duty, Special Forces Major Ateş sets out to uncover the shadowy organization responsible for his death. As his investigation brings him closer to the truth, he faces increasingly dangerous challenges that threaten both his personal life and military career. Driven by grief and a desire for justice, Ateş finds himself caught in a growing conflict between doing what is right and seeking revenge.

title: All Pass
overview: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

title: Petros Eni
overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

title: Devour
overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: The Magpie
overview: A series of encounters in a run-down holiday park change the way an inquisitive young boy perceives the world.

title: Only Me
overview: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

title: Almost There
overview: An aspiring musician nearing thirty grapples with the end of her carefree twenties as life demands she embrace maturity and responsibility.

title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
overview: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

title: Waves Turn
overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

title: Totality
overview: Twenty-one film crews from Mexico to Canada capture the 2024 total solar eclipse, following several groups of people in preparation for this extraordinary event. This immersive cinematic experience explores this magically cosmic spectacle and the collective human awakening it inspired.

title: Center Stage for Murder
overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

title: The Alienist
overview: A small-town psychiatrist loses the sight of distinction between sanity and insanity, beginning to commit anyone.
cast: João Pedro Pires de Fraga Moreira

title: The Trumpeter and the Ghost
overview: A frustrated jazz trumpeter rehearsing for an audition accidentally awakens an invisible ghost with the power to manipulate sound. The ghost promises to turn him into a virtuoso in exchange for his help unearthing an ancient treasure buried deep in the mountains. But what begins as a great deal soon becomes a dangerous adventure leading toward a dark secret.

title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
overview: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

title: Earworm
overview: After spending all day in bed doomscrolling, Reed stumbles upon a video of a mother ‘unaliving’ her baby… while humming the same 4 notes over and over and over. Now every sound that Reed hears in his everyday life morphs into those 4 notes– and with each note, the bloody Mother draws closer.

title: Wake
overview: After committing murder and disposing of the evidence, Ellie (Natasha Lockhart) seeks help in therapy following the tragic event in hope it destroys the sound, pain and fear she has since experienced. The mind is a powerful thing and her own...Let's say it has a mind of its own. Wake marks Leon's debut as an independent writer and director!'  Starring: Natasha Lockhart

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: The Spirit of Halloween
overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

title: Too Soon
overview: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

title: Christmas & Chaos
overview: Two musicians with clashing styles join forces to create music that will wow a powerful impresario and his associate. Their collaboration is key to keeping their show alive and thriving in a competitive industry.
A bankrupt director in need of money to make a dream movie is trying to find her Alzheimer's mother who has just disappeared after promising to sell a house and divide her assets.

title: The Enigma of Franca Farmín
overview: Franca Farmín, a young aspiring YouTuber obsessed with documenting paranormal phenomena, travels to the remote Laguna del Olvido, convinced she can capture the unknown on camera and uncover a mystery that could make her go viral. Franca sets out in search of a legend?and becomes one.

title: Remain Calm
overview: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.

title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

title: Clown Panic
overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
overview: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

title: Squeal
overview: A pig masked killer targets and slaughters drug users.

title: Fresh Meat
overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

title: JINX
overview: A married couple discovers how dangerous it is to be too much like your partner.

title: A Guerra à Santa
overview: Why does a Saint provoke such hatred in those who seek to rule the country?  For many people, Our Lady of Aparecida is the patroness of Brazil—the mother of Jesus.  Yet, Bishop JB Carvalho has labeled Aparecida the “right-hand woman of Satan” and called for her to be stripped of her status as Brazil’s patroness. It was in his very church that Flávio Bolsonaro chose to be baptized. Among so many pastors, why surround oneself with someone who spreads hatred against people’s faith?

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Awake
overview: Based on his writings from a sleepless night in U.S. immigration detention, Mahmoud Khalil reflects on being separated from his family and the fragile promises of democracy, justice, and human dignity.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Djävulens krig
overview: On snow-covered fields in the small village of Napue in Ostrobothnia, a terribly one-sided battle is being fought in the bitter February cold. The Swedish army numbers 4,500 men. The Russian force consists of over 10,000 soldiers. The odds are impossible to overcome, and the Swedish defeat is total. The year is 1714, and the entire eastern half of the kingdom is now under Russian control. The era of the Great Northern War has begun.

title: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
overview: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

title: Let's Have Kids!
overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: Handy Girl
overview: An urgent and punk cinematic diary where documentary and fiction collide. Guided by her handycam, a Buenos Aires underground actress and mother captures her daily fight for self-determination, turning low-fi filmmaking into political and artistic resistance.

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Jailer 2
overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

title: 2 Valid IDs
overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Les Misérables
overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

title: Pee Mak
overview: Mak, a soldier returning home from war, invites four of his comrades to meet his wife and newborn child. However, suspicion soon grows among his friends as they uncover a terrifying secret: Mak’s family is no longer among the living.

title: The Locksmith
overview: The day Rodrigo, an 11-year-old boy, will read his first essay in front of the whole class, both he and those around him will discover the consequences of the peculiar relationship he has with his father and the hobbies they share.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Carapace
overview: When her teenage daughter decides to leave home to study, Maite feels the world she has built begin to fall apart. As the fear of losing her takes hold, a strange presence begins to spread through the house, contaminating both the space and the bond between mother and daughter.

title: Ranabaali
overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

title: The Storm
overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
overview: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

title: Stalling
overview: Minutes before a job interview, a man with a stubborn case of shy bladder becomes the center of an increasingly surreal restroom spectacle as every well-intention attempt to help only makes things worse.

title: Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
overview: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
overview: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

title: Half
overview: A mixed Japanese and Caucasian woman reflects on identity, belonging and the responsibilities and biases that accompany her background.

title: In This Room
overview: In a world that seems to be falling apart, poetry, empathy, and music remind us of the urgent need to understand one another. Through fado and the distinctive voice of its most famous singer, Carminho, a glimmer of hope emerges across the landscapes of a Japan once devastated by bombings. The film follows the Portuguese artist on tour across the country. Through concerts, backstage moments, hotel rooms, taxis, silences, and whispers, the film weaves together the world of fado and Japan’s cultural landscape.

title: Pemuja Syaitan
overview: Former classmates reunite in their coastal hometown to unearth a time capsule, but buried secrets and fractured friendships unleash an unknown terror, leaving six dead, one missing, and a traumatised survivor to help an inspector uncover a sinister truth.

title: Je so’ pazzo
overview: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

title: Redemption River
overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

title: Betta Fish
overview: After her mother disappears, a recent college graduate becomes her younger sister’s caretaker and must reconsider the future she had planned.

title: Synthetic
overview: The film is based on real-life events. Alena, a voice-over star, suddenly discovers that her voice has been stolen by the developers a major bank's neural network. Now her voice can be heard everywhere—from airport announcements to entertainment and gaming platforms. Alena realizes that in the modern reality a person's voice does not fall under legal protection. Thus, not only voice-over actors but everyone is at risk. The actress starts a struggle for the right to her own voice.

title: Vespers
overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

title: Visitation
overview: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

title: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

title: Masterplan
overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

title: Seriously Single Too
overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

title: Nayyi Navelli
overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

title: You Can't Leave
overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

title: Clean Hands
overview: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: The Mirror
overview: Young filmmaker Juan invites Mateo, a former actor who abandoned his artistic ambitions, to star in a short film about two men confronting a forbidden attraction. As rehearsals deepen, the story begins to feel less and less like fiction. Juan and Mateo begin unconsciously mirroring the very relationship they are creating for the screen. Glances linger, boundaries blur and the creative process exposes fears, frustrations and desires neither man is prepared to confront.

title: Crazy Kalyanam
overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

title: Her Song
overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: Holy Relic
overview: When a troubled father discovers a malevolent presence inhabiting a religious artifact, he investigates with the help of his two young sons.

title: In Dreaming
overview: Ryan is destined to dance, but has to put his passion aside to fulfil his duties at his family’s nail salon.

title: Ultimatum
overview: Juni realizes that Martin can no longer stand her. He wants her to undergo an assessment, while she feels that he is putting her in an impossible situation.

title: How to Live Without Going Crazy
White Belt
overview: Set in present-day Los Angeles, this Dramedy follows Rick Dale as he pursues his passion of becoming a writer. When a new student Tay comes in and upsets the balance of the predominately male Jiu Jitsu gym, Rick does everything in his power to try and scare her away. In the end, his hand is forced when he realizes she is an esteemed author he happens to love. In exchange for training, Rick bargains for Tay's tutelage and expertise in the world of prose. Tay makes Rick ultimately realize that he is irrevocably bad at writing and has been shucking his true calling and responsibility of being the Jiu Jitsu champion that he is.

title: Beyond The Eagle Obsession
overview: A companion to "The Eagle Obsession", "Beyond the Eagle Obsession: 50 Years of Fandom” spotlights the passionate collectors, artists, model builders, and fans who have kept the legacy of the Eagle spacecraft alive for half a century.

title: The Interview
overview: Four strangers on their way to a job interview get stuck in a lift. They share their trauma, only to discover that the interview has already begun.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Silver Bells at Christmas
overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
overview: When ambitious freelance reporter Avery Clark returns to Chicago to spend Christmas with her mom and new stepdad, she's hoping for a little holiday downtime before her next assignment. Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.

title: Fashion House
overview: Otto, a young man working at a Moscow fashion house, is preparing for his wedding to his fiancée, Maria. At one of the shows, he meets a teacher he had a crush on in his youth. Their feelings are rekindled. This relationship leads to a series of problems and misfortunes, culminating in a murder in the very heart of the fashion house. This story has narrators—they debate throughout the film the artistic direction of scenes, the genre, and even the color scheme of the characters' outfits. Whether it's a classic detective story, a French comedy, or surrealism in fashionable tones—the viewer will have to decide at the very end.

title: Dioscuri
overview: A guy from the provinces searches for his place between the old world and marginal freedom but rejected by both faces a decisive choice.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Marrow
overview: Madison's hopeless lesbian crush on her straight and taken roommate takes a dark turn when she learns of an arcane recipe for a love potion - one that calls for her own bones.

title: Sins of an Amish Husband
overview: Sarah is a devout Amish woman who suspects foul play after her sister, Ida, dies in a mysterious barn fire. Driven to protect her young nephew, Sarah begins investigating her brother-in-law.

title: Nemesis
overview: After a high school student is assaulted and publicly humiliated, two outcast classmates perform an occult ritual for revenge, unknowingly unleashing the ancient goddess Nemesis.

title: Por el sabor de ese Kebab
Just After Dawn
overview: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason.. and threatens their very existence.

title: Shark Lake
overview: A couple travel to a remote hotel hoping to repair their relationship, only to discover that the mysterious owner is hiding a deadly secret involving his hungry pet shark, Cinnamon.

title: Bravo
overview: Female rage is a peculiar thing. Heartbroken young painter Tina greets the dawn with a gunshot that seems to close the chapter on her failed relationship. Desperate to heal, in search of closure, she turns to an unconventional form of therapy - an intimate ritual that promises clarity and convinces her that she may finally be able to let go of her former lover.

title: Being Ben
overview: With his NBA career getting a restart this season with the Sacramento Kings, former No. 1 draft pick Ben Simmons opens up in a new ESPN E60 documentary about the highs and lows of his extraordinary career, his attempt to reclaim his place in the game – and his lifelong passion for fishing.

title: Le ragazzine stanno perdendo il controllo. La società le teme. La fine è azzurra.
Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: #Vymara
overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

title: Garv
overview: Garv's only trying to get ahead. Fresh into a new life in Melbourne, he's landed a decent job, a shot at succes, and a workplace that's anything but welcoming. As the cracks begin to show, a few harmless jokes turn into something harder to ignore. But when speaking up makes him the problem, Garv's forced to confront an uncomfortable truth; sometimes, fitting in comes at a cost.

title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
overview: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

title: Capturing Bigfoot
overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

title: La Marea
overview: Tracing the waters of the Santa Barbara Channel and the passage surrounding the Channel Islands, guided by the belief of many coastal tribes that souls of the dead travel west over the ocean, La Marea explores the sea as a threshold between the living and the departed. Through tides, light and shifting currents, ancestral cosmologies intertwine with contemporary stories of exile and return. Created in dialogue with Bryan Senti’s musical composition, part of a larger body of work inspired by his father’s exile from Cuba by sea, La Marea carries these oceanic crossings into a shared reflection on displacement, remembrance and the invisible forces that continue to move through us.

title: Anti-Princesas
overview: At the Neza-Bordo prison, ten incarcerated women take part in a theater workshop led by La Cana. Through rehearsals, the stage becomes a space to name violence, revisit their own stories and recover a voice that was silenced for years.  Anti-Princesas follows this process up to the final performance in front of their families, interweaving the theater work with the participants' testimonies. Their accounts reveal stories marked by gender-based violence, abusive relationships, long periods without a sentence, and a justice system that often fails to effectively apply the gender perspective set out in Mexican law.  More than a film about prison, Anti-Princesas is a collective portrait of ten women who, from confinement, find in theater a form of resistance, expression and freedom.

title: 13 Alfinetes
overview: Miracles still happen—or so they say… What is the place of the sacred in the contemporary world?  Looking again at a myth that haunts us, that of Saint Anthony of Lisbon (and also of Padua), through the timeless painting of Goya, 13 Alfinetes is a story of love, revenge, and blood. It begins with a reenactment of an episode supposedly occurring in medieval Lisbon, filtered through the cosmopolitan 18th-century Madrid, and returning to Lisbon today, where miracles, in truth, no longer happen.

title: 7 anniversari
overview: Love blossoms between Teo and Emma, ​​two young people still finding their way in life. But Emma is afraid of commitment, and Teo has an idea and proposes a deal: their relationship will last exactly seven years. This way, from the beginning, they will both know when it's time to say goodbye, and Emma's fear of suffering will no longer exist.

title: Wicker
overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: La Gradiva
overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

title: Coward
overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by tenderness, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

title: Hanging by a Wire
overview: On a Tuesday morning in August 2023, a group of kids set off for school, climbing into a makeshift cable car for the journey across a mountain pass in northwest Pakistan. What happened next would make headlines around the world. Suddenly, 900 feet above the ground, two cables snapped, putting the teenagers in mortal danger.

title: Karma
overview: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

title: Last Generation
overview: Lucas, a baby desperate for his parents' attention, finally finds the solution: his mother’s mobile phone. Little does he know that by getting what he so desired, he will open the door to a future no one could have foreseen.

title: Le Roi du Game
overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

title: Zumbido
overview: "On a film set, a sound recordist detects a strange noise interfering with the filming. Meanwhile, the self-centered director disregards her, focusing only on giving flawed guidance to the actor.

title: Marie Madeleine
overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

title: Paradise Lost
overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

title: Kill Harry
overview: Harry captures the magic at Muni and explores the cuts with an undeniable roster of Philly stars. Panebianco, Ward, O'Dwyer and more—this is essential East Coast viewing.

title: Tote Oma
overview: German Democratic Republic, 1989: Margot leads a quiet, orderly life with her party-loyal husband. Every day is the same between household chores, television and the same familiar rituals. In a world that promises her security and stability, the monotony of her daily life becomes increasingly noticeable. A young neighbor and a goldfish bring movement into Margot’s rigid routine.

title: Multwoh: Patay na Patay Sa'yo
overview: When a college queer dies suddenly in their dorm, they return as a ghost — not to seek revenge, but to say the one thing they never found the courage to say in life: "I love you".

title: The Shadow
overview: A haunted house security guard encounters a spooky shadow.

title: Lily Brett - Laughter Can Pierce Pain
overview: In 1948, a little girl sits smiling on a Parisian carousel – for the first time she experiences a moment of carefree childhood. Her parents are Holocaust survivors; Lily Brett was born just after the end of World War II in a DP camp in Feldafing. The writer Lily Brett artistically explores the trauma she inherited in a remarkable way, marked by gentle humor rather than bitterness or anger. Not as an accuser, but as a bridgebuilder.

title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

title: La venganza del Charro Negro
overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
overview: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

title: The Perfect Holiday
overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

title: ¿Querés ser mi hijo?
overview: Lucía, a 42-year-old woman, discovers her partner's infidelity after a 15-year relationship and must reorganize her personal and professional life. She asks her young neighbor to pretend to be her son for a job opportunity.

title: Fokus
overview: Jaana, a top coach at the elite club Fokus, suffers a medical emergency under mysterious circumstances, leaving Olympic hopeful Tove in need of a new coach. When former star skater Miina returns to the club, a quest for revenge ignites a volatile power struggle in which no one’s reputation is safe.  *Fokus* is an intense miniseries set in the glittering yet harsh world of figure skating.

title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

title: Sending Spree
overview: Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, becoming the first woman ever to climb both V15 boulders and 5.15 routes.

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

title: Full Circle
overview: A mother and son search for the perfect vantage point to witness a total solar eclipse. Once totality hits, past, present and future become blurred.

title: Naa Wife Missing
overview: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

title: Pesca
overview: In Panama, 12-year-old Clara goes fishing for “mahi-mahi“ dolphinfish with her father. As they venture further from the shore, the unease he stirs in her grows increasingly oppressive.

title: Pirunduk
overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

title: Echo Chamber
overview: An exploration in narcissistic desire, a kind of autoeroticopsis in being the subject of desire for yourself.

title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
overview: The feature-length documentary on the historic year of 1936 in Venezuela: the first year of Eleazar López Contreras's government, following the death of Juan Vicente Gómez and 27 years of dictatorship. A film that shows, like never before, a portrait of the Venezuelan people and of a changing society. 90 years later, this documentary—an unprecedented historical audiovisual record—recreates an image of the past that is unique in its kind for Venezuelan historiography.

title: Ekeko: el muñeco de la suerte
overview: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. In her desperation, she decides to invoke a traditional Ekeko doll to heal and change her destiny. However, what initially seems to bring her good fortune soon transforms into her worst nightmare. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

title: Gajab Raat
overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Lapland War
overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: Haiku
overview: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

title: Making Marie Antoinette
overview: Eleanor Coppola turns her camera on her daughter, Sofia, as she shoots Marie Antoinette. Catching every detail of the behind-the-scenes and on-set action, Eleanor captures the feat of Sofia’s directing a landmark film aged 34, and muses on what it means for a mother to watch her daughter at work.

title: Drama Kings
overview: It is about two struggling actors, Krille and Martin, who discover that a famous producer has stolen their film idea about a kidnapping. They decide to stage a kidnapping of their own, but things get out of hand.

title: Love Language
overview: After a failed engagement, a woman discovers a talent for writing wedding vows, but her growing success and new romance are complicated when she’s hired to write vows for her former college flame’s wedding.

title: Nhang
overview: A young mother attempts to carry on the Vietnamese tradition of đám giỗ with her young son. As she lights the incense, the ritual transports her back to memories of childhood and the grandmother who taught her how to carry tradition forward. But the memories reveal something she had forgotten. Now, she must decipher what it means to honor the past while making room for something of her own.

title: Winter Wonderlanes
overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind.
